title: TAP Portugal v flightright and Myflyright (Joined Cases C-156/22 to C-158/22), 11 May 2023
source: TAP Portugal v flightright and Myflyright (Joined Cases C-156/22 to C-158/22), 11 May 2023
excerpt: the unexpected absence – due to illness or death of a crew member whose presence is essential to the operation of a flight – which occurred shortly before the scheduled departure of that flight, does not fall within the concept of ‘extraordinary circumstances’ within the meaning of that provision.
summary: The unexpected absence of an essential crew member through illness or death shortly before departure is not an extraordinary circumstance.
